text.en: Guille Ojeda is a Principal Innovation Architect in Caylent's Office of the CTO, based in Córdoba, Argentina. He writes Simple AWS and speaks about AWS architecture and applied AI. He is an AWS Community Builder, leads AWS AI User Group Argentina, and was named AWS Builder of the Year for LATAM-ES 2025.
text.es: Guille Ojeda es Principal Innovation Architect en la oficina del CTO de Caylent y vive en Córdoba, Argentina. Escribe Simple AWS y da charlas sobre arquitectura AWS e IA aplicada. Es AWS Community Builder, lidera AWS AI User Group Argentina y fue reconocido como AWS Builder of the Year para LATAM-ES 2025.

intro.en: Two published books, a new book in progress, and a video course on deploying applications to AWS.
intro.es: Dos libros publicados, un nuevo libro en preparación y un curso en video sobre despliegue de aplicaciones en AWS.

courseText.en: A 12-hour course across 19 modules, based on Node.js on AWS, on deploying scalable, highly available applications.
courseText.es: Un curso de 12 horas en 19 módulos, basado en Node.js on AWS, sobre despliegue de aplicaciones escalables y de alta disponibilidad.

intro.en: Today I work as Principal Innovation Architect at Caylent’s Office of the CTO, helping turn emerging cloud and AI ideas into useful systems and clear explanations.
intro.es: Hoy trabajo como Principal Innovation Architect en la oficina del CTO de Caylent, ayudando a convertir ideas emergentes de cloud e IA en sistemas útiles y explicaciones claras.

community.en: I’m an AWS Community Builder in Serverless, an AWS User Group Leader for AWS AI User Group Argentina, and AWS Builder of the Year for LATAM-ES 2025. I also organize community events and help other builders share their work.
